_note: Weights sum to 100: the most AI a video could use. A video's score is the sum of weight x level over the categories it used. Tier 1 is the big four (AI wrote it, directed it, generated the picture, generated the sound); mastering is the least.

_kinds_note: What you're scoring decides which questions are asked and how much each weighs. Weights are relative: after dropping any question answered "doesn't apply" (never allowed on a kind's core question), the rest are scaled to add up to 100, so 0 and 100 are always reachable. Video uses the original weights unchanged, so old links score the same. 'extras' are optional parts a piece can have (code with graphics or sound); ticking one adds its questions.
